description: When: choosing a model, estimating a cost or checking a context window. Prices and context windows are read daily from each provider's own pricing page (prices_as_of, price_status on every price). Gives, by what you pass: models → their facts, side by side when 2-5; models + input_tokens (+ output_tokens) → cost per model; models + messages → does the conversation fit each window (the one gated answer); provider → the catalogue; use_case / features / max_budget / vram_gb → a shortlist on facts; text → its token count. Does not prove: which model is best for your task: only running your own cases on each tells that.

messages.description: [{role, content}]: checked against each model's window.

provider.description: List one provider's models ("all" for every one).

name: model_catalogue
